summary: Durable Slack delivery and bounded owner-session context startup
reason: Reduce avoidable transport loss, repeated context reads and ambiguity while preserving existing execution and authorization boundaries.

tests.name: durable-transport
tests.evidence: 9 scenarios passed, including restart, timeout reconciliation and history pagination without replay

tests.name: runtime-contract
tests.evidence: 6 tests passed; outdated fixed sleep assertion replaced by descriptor-release invariant

tests.name: slack-regression
tests.evidence: existing Slack core and resilience suites passed, including oversized output and 429 reconnect

capabilities.reason: Paired ui-playbooks change updates device.remote_bridge registry and operating contract.

architecture.reason: Extends the existing adapter with a transport-only journal and read-only context entrypoint; no new execution owner or service.

rollback: Restore preceding immutable release and installer backups; revert source commits while retaining private delivery records for inspection.
limitations: ChatGPT client timing and platform confirmation policy are external.
Slack response publication is at least once; uncertain acknowledgment can duplicate a response.
History catch-up is bounded and never automatically executes unseen commands.
ChatGPT project settings are not edited by the local installer.
Runtime activation evidence is recorded separately after immutable release acceptance.
